title: Uniform distribution under coordinate projection
statement: Let $A$ be a finite nonempty set, and let $e:\{0,\ldots,M-1\}\hookrightarrow\{0,\ldots,R-1\}$ be an injection. For a uniformly chosen function $x:\{0,\ldots,R-1\}\to A$, the function $i\mapsto x(e(i))$ is uniformly distributed among all functions from $\{0,\ldots,M-1\}$ to $A$.
hypotheses_covered: $e$ is an injection from the $M$ coordinate indices to the $R$ coordinate indices
